verdict.rationale: Maritime automatically puts agents and web apps to sleep when idle and wakes them on demand ("sleep/wake economics"), with always-on offered as a separate add-on, so idle shutdown is the default behavior. However, nothing shows a developer can set a timeout value, and billing is a flat subscription with no meters, so sleeping does not stop billing in the per-use sense the story implies. Missing for 10: configurable idle or max-lifetime timeout settings, explicit terminate-when-done controls, documentation tying sleep to stopped charges, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
